title.narrative: Promoting Equity, Accountability, and Cohesion through Engagement (PEACE) in South Omo.

description.narrative: The proposed action is strategically designed to contribute to the EU CSF+'s higher-level goal of strengthened civil society engagement in governance, conflict prevention, and social development. To foster sustainable peace, social cohesion, and inclusive development among the Dasenech, Hamar, and Arbore communities of South Omo by addressing root causes of conflict and building resilient, community-owned systems for peace. Specifically, it will deliver on the following key result areas: Reduce the quarterly number of reported inter‑community violent incidents in the 12 target kebeles of Hamar and Dasenech by ≥40% from baseline to Month 18, measured via EWER logs and Peace & Security records; disaggregated by kebele and incident type.Increase the share of community members reporting “high trust” toward other groups from baseline by ≥30% by Month 18; ensure participation quotas of ≥30% women, ≥20% youth, ≥5% PWDs in reconciliation activities.Raise the proportion of youth who agree that “violence is never an acceptable means to resolve disputes” from baseline by ≥50% by Month 18, using school/community surveys.Operationalize 2 inter‑ethnic EWER systems and 2 joint resource management plans (Hamar–Dasenech, Hamar–Arbore), with ≥40% women and ≥30% youth in governance roles; ≥60% of surveyed residents report satisfaction with dispute resolution pathways.
